✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

✘ Alter the base GHL

If approved, the rights must be renewed after **12 months** by submitting a new request.

Ti abbiamo assegnato il nuovo PC con Service TAG YT8BJX6 Provvederemo a spedirti il nuovo PC nella filiale di Torino. Puoi darci conferma della filiale? A breve riceverai due mail: 1) Una relativa alla nuova assegnazione 2) Una relativa alla restituzione del tuo attuale device (da non considerare in caso hai esercitato il diritto di prelazione) Questo ticket verrà aggiornato quando il PC sarà disponibile per il ritiro in filiale. Ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio PC. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. Il vecchio PC viene formattato/riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di ritiro del nuovo device. Link utili: - Policy di assegnazione dei dispositivi aziendali https://shorturl.policy1 - Guide IT https://shorturl.guides1 L'IT provvederà alla cancellazione sicura dei tuoi dati ed al ripristino come condizioni di fabbrica del tuo vecchio pc. ------------------------------------------------- Your PC is obsolete and out of warranty. We will change your old device with Service TAG 4FRJN29 to a new one. We have assigned you the new device with Service TAG YT8BJX6 We will send you the new PC to the Turin office. Can you give us the confirmation of the branch? You will receive two emails: 1) Regarding the new PC assigned to you 2) Regarding the return of the old one (Please ignore if you already exercise the redeem old PC) This ticket will be updated when the device can be picked up in the office. We remind you that you can redeem your old PC. To exercise the pre-emption it's sufficient to confirm it in the ticket, after that we will contact you for resetting your old device remotely. If you'll receive an email asking you to return the old one, please ignore it. The price is 60 € for PC and 160 € for MacOS. NOTES: Remember that the pre-emption is valid if: You exercise the redemption of the old device within 7 days from the date of creation of this ticket. The old PC will be reset/returned to the IT office within 30 days from the date you picked up the new device. Useful links: - Device Policy https://shorturl.policy1 - IT Guides: https://shorturl.guides1 The IT will provide for the secure deletion of your data and the restoration of your old PC to factory conditions.

VIA TEVERE 20 / floor 4 20139 Milano, Italia T +39 02 123456 F +39 02 789012 M +39 338123456 Matteo.Russo@abc.com [https://abc.com](http://short.url) [https://blog.abc.com](http://short.url) [https://www.linkedin.com/company/abc-technologies/](http://short.url) [https://www.twitter.com/abc_it](http://short.url) Registered office: ABC Italia S.r.l., Via Tevere 20, 20139 Milan (Italy) VAT Code and number of registration with the Companies' Register of Milan: 00819200478 Corporate capital: Euro 1,000,000 fully paid-in Company subject to the direction and coordination activity of ABC Technologies SE Ai sensi del Regolamento UE 2016/679 (GDPR) e delle Linee Guida per posta elettronica ed Internet del Garante Privacy si rende noto che le informazioni contenute nella presente comunicazione e i relativi allegati possono essere riservate e sono, comunque, destinate esclusivamente alle persone o alla Società sopraindicati. Le stesse non sono da considerarsi comunicazioni personali, quindi eventuali risposte potranno essere conosciute da persone appartenenti all’azienda. In accordance with Regulation EU 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation) and Guidelines Applying to the Use of E-Mails and the Internet in the Employment Context of Italian Data Protection Authority it is announced that the information in this communication (which includes any documents with it) is confidential and meant only for above-mentioned persons and/or Companies; the information is not personal therefore, It is intended for the addressee only and any replies will be known by people belonging to the company. _________________________________________________ Da: Giulia Bellucci <g.bellucci@gmail.com> Inviato: giovedì 11 luglio 2024 18:20 A: ISP TF Governance <ISP.TF.Governance.Italy@abc.com>; Russo, Matteo <Matteo.Russo@abc.com> Cc: daniele.derrico@clx.com Oggetto: Aggiornamento assenza di Giulia Bellucci Some people who received this message don't often get email from g.bellucci@gmail.com. [Learn why this is important](https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification) [EXTERNAL EMAIL] This email originated from outside of the organization or was sent unauthenticated. Do not click links or open attachments unless you confirm the sender and know the content is safe. Buonasera, con la seguente vi scrivo per aggiornarvi rispetto alla mia assenza. In particolare sono assente dal 08/07, giorno in cui dovevo rientrare dalle ferie come previsto dal piano condiviso, per l'impossibilità di accedere sia ai sistemi ABC che agli ambienti di test ISP, in quanto il mio telefono è in assistenza. Di seguito riporto quanto fatto già lunedì mattina per poter risolvere: - ho messo la SIM su un nuovo telefono per poter ricevere i codici OTP per SMS o telefonata, dalla print in allegato potete vedere che al momento dell'accesso queste opzioni non mi sono concesse; - provato a riconfigurare l'app MIcrosoft Authenticator sul telefono di backup, ma senza quello principale mi è stato impossibile fare il passaggio da un dispositivo all'altro; - richiesto il supporto tramite colleghi per ricevere assistenza lato ABC, ma l'unica opzione presentata è stata quella già descritta al punto 1 In seguito agli ultimi aggiornamenti ricevuti dal centro assistenza realisticamente non riuscirò a rientrare prima di lunedì 15, ma resto a disposizione qualora ci fosse qualunque altra cosa che posso fare. In ogni caso sarà mia premura scrivervi qui per ogni novità. Saluti, Giulia Bellucci

- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GXK employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Laura Bianchi (Milano) (B72D)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GXK-LM8Kv7QrJSf (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GXK & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
PEF_J89012 - ID24-R9446 - Forborne (JE564119-614) Banco BPM
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
I need administrator permissions to download the RAD (Rational Application Developer) application and related programmes required to configure the working environment.
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GXK Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GXK Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GXK Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GXK Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GXK Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GXK Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GXK Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

This request requires additional information before it can be processed.

The easiest way to provide it is to open a new request through the portal using the following service:

[Corporate computers – I need administrator rights on my computer](https://short.url)

Alternatively, please provide the following information in this ticket:

   - **Yes:** Please use the subcategory **“I need software or a license installed on my computer”**.  
   - **No:** Explain why recurring administrator access is required.

4. **Clients and projects you work on:**

5. **Justification:**  
   Please list the software and actions requiring administrator rights, for example Adobe applications and the Wacom driver. Confirm whether Group IT cannot perform the installation.

6. **Local Admin Rights Policy:**  
   Please review the [Omicron Corp Local Admin Rights Policy](https://short.url).

7. **Policy confirmation:**  
   Please confirm:  
   **“Yes, I have read carefully and understood the concepts. I agree to follow it.”**

Permanent local administrator access is only approved for regular, recurring business activities and requires appropriate justification. Temporary access should be requested for short-term or one-time installations that Group IT cannot complete. Please also confirm with your manager that the request does not conflict with any client requirements.

If the requested information is not provided, this ticket will be closed after five working days.

Best regards,  
Group IT

Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your ABC employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: John Smith (Milano) (B25H)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: ABC-xYZZPOAbCDE (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, ABC & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
XYZ - Taxonomy Tool
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
Need to be able to install and apply changes to installed software, as ABC Editor, Notepad++, Docker
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- ABC Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base ABC Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the ABC Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from ABC Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of ABC Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between ABC Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a ABC Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base ABC Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the ABC/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible

feedback.answer:
Hello,

To renew your administrator rights, please submit the **Local Administrator Rights (LAR) request form** and provide the following information:

- Confirm that you require **long-term rights** for recurring administrative tasks.
- Full name of your manager or approver at **level L6 or above**. If you are L6 or above, enter your own name.
- Your computer name. You can find it in the Company Portal under **Device Name**, or by running `hostname` in Command Prompt.
- Computer operating system.
- Clients and projects you support.
- A specific justification, including the software or administrative actions requiring elevated rights.

Please confirm with your manager that local administrator rights are permitted under any applicable client requirements. Permanent administrator rights are approved only for recurring business needs and must not be used to alter the base system, disable security services, or install unauthorized software.

Approved rights must be renewed every **12 months**; a new request is required at that time.

- DVL Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base DVL Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the DVL Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from DVL Group may request LAR privileges.

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between DVL Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a DVL Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies
